measured_canonical_raw.note: single venue (BINANCE USD-M perpetual), four fixed contracts, three dataset families: klines whose rows carry the seven-field OHLCV shape only, that venue's funding, and its instrument definitions. No trade, aggTrade, tick, quote or book dataset of any kind; the finest stored interval is 300 (300s) and the only quarter-hour-aligned bars are 15m bars covering 900s, against a registered measurement window of 10s. The record's six-contract universe is present at 3/6 (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT); XRPUSDT, DOGEUSDT and ADAUSDT do not exist locally and BNBUSDT is not in the record's universe.

matrix.detail: Required data item 1 (DECISIVE): 'Instruments: BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, DOGE, ADA perpetual futures for direct source reproduction.' Locally only three of the six exist (BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT,SOLUSDT); ADAUSDT, DOGEUSDT, XRPUSDT do not exist at any interval or depth, and BNBUSDT is present although the record does not register it. The record's universe is therefore not expressible without shrinking it, which the card forbids.
BTCUSDT exists as a BINANCE USD-M CryptoPerpetual at seven intervals (15m/1d/1h/1w/30m/4h/5m), window 2022-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 .. 2026-09-15T23:00:00+00:00, quote and settlement currency USDT.
ETHUSDT exists as a BINANCE USD-M CryptoPerpetual; one of the six registered contracts and one of the four local ones.
SOLUSDT exists as a BINANCE USD-M CryptoPerpetual; the record itself marks SOL as the weakest contract at some horizons (8h insignificant), which cannot be examined here either.

Required data item 1 (DECISIVE): XRPUSDT does not exist in the canonical raw - no klines directory, no funding file and no instrument definition (measured: local klines dirs BNBUSDT,BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT,SOLUSDT). Without it the source's 'every market' result cannot be reproduced or falsified per asset.

Required data item 1 (DECISIVE): DOGEUSDT does not exist in the canonical raw (no klines/funding/instrument entry). DOGE carries the largest source-reported slopes (11.33 bps at 12h), so this absence alone removes the strongest contract from any local reproduction.
Required data item 1 (DECISIVE): ADAUSDT does not exist in the canonical raw. The source's evidence includes ADA (weaker cells), so a three-contract run would estimate a different population.

The registered venue is present: BINANCE, market_type usdm_perp, four CryptoPerpetual instruments, quote/settlement USDT, funding rows from the same venue (2022-01-01T00:00:00.006000+00:00 .. 2026-09-16T08:00:00.002000+00:00, truth_status values modeled_funding,official).

Required data item 2 (DECISIVE for falsification item 6): the record registers Bybit as the cross-exchange robustness leg ('Bybit is relevant only to reported cross-exchange robustness of the periodic structure'). No second venue of any kind exists in the raw tree: market dirs ['usdm'], non-binance paths [], funding venues ['BINANCE']. Locally Bybit exists only as two cached web pages under ~/.hermes/cache/web/. The retired engine stacks, which the store's own INVENTORY.md lists as holding LEAN sample data for bybit/coinbase/bitfinex crypto, are gone from disk (measured: True).

Required data items 3-4 (DECISIVE): 'Time resolution: individual trades or data granular enough to reconstruct the first 10 seconds of every quarter-hour boundary' and 'Required fields: millisecond timestamp, trade price, quantity, aggressor side / isBuyerMaker equivalent'. The store holds three dataset families ['funding', 'instruments', 'klines (Binance USD-M perpetual futures, UTC)'] and no trade/aggTrade/tick/quote dataset at any depth (39 probe tokens over 1633 entry names: 0 hits), no row shape carries an aggressor side or taker split, and the store's own SCHEMA.md documents the coverage limit: the import kept OHLCV only, so `quote_volume`, trade count and taker-buy splits are not present. The missing prerequisite is the signal's own input, not an auxiliary filter.

The registered measurement window is the first 10s of each quarter-hour opening. The finest stored interval is 300s (30.0x the window) and the only quarter-hour-aligned bars are 15m bars covering 900s (90.0x the window); the store's documented ladder bottoms out at 1m (60s) and is bars-only. Bars are OHLCV aggregates, so the first-10-second signed flow cannot be recovered at any interval. Boundary alignment itself is present (aligned bars open exactly on :00/:15/:30/:45), so alignment is not the missing part.

Required data item 4 (DECISIVE): the stored kline row shape is ['close', 'close_time_ms', 'high', 'low', 'open', 'open_time_ms', 'volume'] and the funding row keys are ['funding_price_source', 'funding_rate', 'funding_time_ms', 'mark_price', 'market_type', 'rate_type', 'symbol', 'truth_status', 'venue'] - neither carries a millisecond trade timestamp, a trade price, a trade quantity or an isBuyerMaker/aggressor field. The instrument export carries maker_fee/taker_fee only (no trade-side field).

Required data item 5: 'Derived fields: buyer-initiated and seller-initiated volume, signed order flow, total volume, quarter-hour phase, forward returns.' The first three need aggressor-side trade rows; only bar VOLUME and the phase are expressible locally, and a bar volume cannot be split by aggressor.

Required data item 6: 'Price anchor: source main tests use transaction-price anchoring'. The only local prices are bar open/high/low/close strings - bar aggregates, not transaction prices - and the source additionally measures forward log return 'from the price immediately after the signal interval', which needs the last trade of the 10-second window.

Required data item 6 (appendix leg): 'appendix robustness also examines bid-ask mid-price anchoring over the period where quote data are available'. No quote, book, depth or bid/ask dataset exists anywhere in the tree (probe tokens bidask/bid_ask/bookticker/book_ticker/orderbook/level2/l2book: 0 hits) and none appears in the documented dataset families ['funding', 'instruments', 'klines (Binance USD-M perpetual futures, UTC)'].

Required data item 7: 'exact Binance exchange timestamp convention must be preserved; boundary alignment errors are a first-order risk'. Local klines carry open_time_ms/close_time_ms in UTC and are exactly grid-aligned (15m opens mod 900 = [0, 0, 0]; 5m opens mod 300 = [0, 0, 0]; daily opens mod 86400 = [0, 0, 0]), so the clock convention is reconstructible for BARS - but there is no trade timestamp stream to align, which is where the record's first-order risk lives.

Required data item 8 (restored from the record; the card's excerpt stops at item 7): 'only trades observed inside the completed first 10-second signal window may enter the signal'. There are no trade observations at all, so the discipline has no substrate.

Required data item 9 (restored from the record): 'missing or incomplete boundary windows should be excluded rather than imputed silently'. No boundary window is observable, so there is neither an exclusion nor an imputation decision to make - and nothing was imputed.

The forward-return horizons exist locally as bars (1h/4h klines for the four local contracts), but only as bar closes: the return is registered to start from the price immediately after the signal interval, which cannot be identified. Registered as a local proxy, not as the record's measurement.

The record reports that excluding quarter-hours coinciding with funding settlement leaves the pattern intact; the funding rows needed for that control exist locally for the four contracts (2022-01-01T00:00:00.006000+00:00 .. 2026-09-16T08:00:00.002000+00:00, truth_status modeled_funding,official, venue BINANCE).

Record falsification item 2 requires shifted placebo grids (01/16/31/46) built from the same 10-second measurement. With no trade stream the placebo and the treatment are both undefined, so the quarter-hour conditioning mechanism cannot be tested either way.

Record falsification item 3 needs controls for ordinary contemporaneous order imbalance, recent returns, volatility, volume and bid-ask-bounce proxies. Returns, volatility and volume are derivable from local bars; order imbalance and the bid-ask-bounce proxy are not (no trades, no quotes), so the control set is structurally incomplete.

The record's falsification plan is 8 items (the card's excerpt carries 7; item 8 is restored verbatim in the round-spec). Items 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8 all need the trade-level measurement; item 5 needs it too plus the record's post-2024 window; item 7 needs a feasible execution rule over the same signal. None is evaluable here, and the missing prerequisite is recorded, not scored: the candidate is neither validated nor refuted.

Required-data window: the record reports its regression sample as 2021-01-01 .. 2024-10-31. The raw's own window is 2022-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 .. 2026-09-15T23:00:00+00:00 (1718 days), so the record's first year is not covered locally either. Registered rather than resolved: under either window the deciding absence is the same.

The record states the source 'does not prescribe a single production threshold for |OI_t|, a mandatory holding horizon among 4/8/12 hours, whether overlapping signals should stack or replace one another, position sizing, or a transaction-cost-aware entry filter'. Registered as read from the record; no default was invented in its place.

Registered from the card: canonical instrument metadata (maker/taker), actual funding per fill, slippage baseline 1 tick adverse with a 2-tick robustness cell. Nothing was priced because nothing traded.
The instrument export carries maker_fee/taker_fee, price_increment and size_increment for the four local perpetuals (fields: maker_fee,taker_fee), which is what the card's cost rail would consume.
The card's per-fill accounting rail (fee + funding at each fill instant, independent gross-PnL accumulator) is registered verbatim in the round-spec; no fill exists to account for.
